scope: Read-only W009 WSL resource coexistence planner with a manual qualification runbook for the remaining installed rows; not installed-product, Windows-headroom or two-user qualification
implemented: Exact, bounded (64 KiB) read of the current user's global .wslconfig with no reparse following; strict UTF-8, control-character, canonical [wsl2] section and memory/swap/processors key, duplicate-key and unit checks fail to an unknown state that blocks planning and proposes nothing

Effective WSL VM limit derived as the configured memory value, the configured value capped at physical memory, or the WSL default of half of physical memory; configured swap is reported but never counted as model capacity

Sampled observation of Windows available memory and the single per-user vmmemWSL working set and private bytes, with the configuration hashed before and after sampling and the inventory read through the existing preflight wsl --list parser

Peak Windows foreground use across samples plus a 1-GiB low-water reserve bounds the maximum VM limit; peak other WSL resident use plus the 5905580032-byte hosted inference start budget bounds the minimum, both constants joined by test to HostedInferenceContract

Closed-record validation of every observation field; an ambiguous or unreadable VM process, an inconsistent sample, a changed configuration, an unavailable inventory or a stopped shared VM with other WSL2 distributions registered yields blocked-observation

Statuses blocked-observation, current-limit-fits, change-proposed and no-feasible-limit; a proposal names only the [wsl2] memory setting, a whole-GiB or whole-MiB value, the direction, every affected WSL2 distribution and its state, and requires a WSL restart and owner-reviewed maintenance with applied=false
The planner never edits .wslconfig, never stops, starts or terminates WSL, never reserves memory and never raises memory automatically; a no-feasible-limit result proposes nothing
Product distribution names accept LumaOS- development names and the exact LumaHosted-<release>-<generation>-<installation> slot form

Manual qualification runbook covers installed first launch, TTY, PAM and health; protection and provider; real compact inference; scoped ingestion; lifecycle and resource coexistence including Windows headroom; confinement; and the W022 two-user proof, from a downloaded package location with no optical media

actual_read_only_host_observation.interpretation: On this development host the measured Windows reserve and the other WSL use plus compact inference start cannot both fit; the planner proposes nothing and admits nothing

limitations: The installed hosted service imports its slot as LocalSystem; that slot does not appear in the owner's wsl --list, and a second vmmemWSL process makes interactive planning return blocked-observation. Attribution of the service VM and the configuration WSL applies to it needs the installed runbook rows.

Luma.Preflight.psm1 -DistributionName accepts only LumaOS- names, so preflight cannot yet name a LumaHosted- slot; the coexistence planner accepts both forms. Preflight was not edited because profile V imports it.
Each Windows user has a separate WSL VM; other users' VMs count as Windows-side use here and are not attributed. Two-user coexistence (W022) remains a runbook row.

Windows foreground responsiveness under the declared workload (QW04), combined saturation (V04), guest-observed limits, installed per-service cgroup limits and joining the measured reserve to dispatch-time inference admission are not measured.
The development host was observed read-only and is not a qualified target. No runbook row has been executed.
No host settings, .wslconfig, account, service, distribution, policy or encryption configuration changed. WSL was not shut down or terminated. No model was executed.
